purpose: Two-clip development diagnostic: can predicted or GT protection improve independently decoded fish fidelity under the existing complete-file budget?

groups.C: Frozen base_tiles512 + recall_hold1 cached fish/diver union alpha protects original RGB; same low-pass elsewhere
groups.O: Offline fish GT protection using the same dilation, one-frame seed history, soft edge and fallback rule; not deployable and not a guaranteed upper bound

preprocessing.gaussian: scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter on float32 RGB, sigma=(2,2,0), mode=reflect, truncate=4; round/clamp to uint8
preprocessing.blend: round(alpha_uint8/255 * original_uint8 + (1-alpha_uint8/255) * blurred_uint8), float32 then clamp to uint8

codec.implementation: Existing C-round NeuralCodec.frame with existing native entropy backend; new experiment harness only
codec.baseline_anchor: A@q32 for each clip, written before non-A encoding
codec.independent_receiver: Separate process, decoder_only=True, accepts stream and output paths without original images or GT; existing media-read guard and ordered reconstruction verification
codec.precision: Existing deterministic FP32 codec arithmetic, no neural algorithm or weight changes
codec.on_failure: Keep failure evidence, fix harness issues only; do not silently shrink resolution, change precision, or expand points

budget.S0: Actual complete A@q32 glcv bytes per clip, fixed before semantic results
budget.selection: Largest actual complete file within each ceiling per group; tie chooses lower q; no GT/quality-based point selection
budget.hard_cap: 10*S_semantic <= 11*S0 per clip; over-cap exploratory points never count as deliverables
budget.counted_bytes: Complete glcv; no extra per-clip decoder side data required by sender-only preprocessing
budget.unmatched: Report actual sizes and rate-matching insufficiency; neither infer semantic failure nor equal-byte benefit

evaluation.reference: Original unprocessed D0 RGB and independent fish GT for all frames, including missed fish
evaluation.primary: Pooled RGB squared error and PSNR on GT fish and its complement, per clip
evaluation.controls: Compare C and O to both A and B selected under each identical ceiling; also show same-q differences and actual bytes
evaluation.near_equal_category: C or O no larger than comparator and within 2% of its actual size; evaluate A and B separately
evaluation.visual: Produce synchronized same-scale original/A/B/C/O target-crop previews and a method-hidden view with a separate key; static checks are not continuous-playback validation
evaluation.limitations: Two development clips share one source group, no diver-video or held-out validation; GT is a diagnostic reference, not a guaranteed upper bound

integrity_note: Do not rescan D0 or semantic weights. Keep existing codec initialization and newly generated stream verification intact.
